prose: Premortem is a web tool where you paste a startup idea and six AI agents try to tear it apart, covering market, tech, competition and unit economics, among other angles. A seventh agent writes the memo.

The page claims over 2,400 ideas red-teamed and about 90 seconds per memo. Basis: only the landing page was available, so those figures are the site's own claims and there is no evidence about quality.
highlights: Six agents critique an idea; a seventh synthesizes a memo.
Claims 2,400+ ideas processed and under 90 seconds per memo.
